memorisation.welcomeBack.freshReminderTr: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.1.tra: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.1.int: Even a few ayahs, done with sincerity, are beloved to Allah.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.2.tra: As for those who strive for Us, We shall guide them to Our paths.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.2.int: Returning with steadiness is part of the path — one ayah at a time.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.3.tra: So remember Me; I will remember you.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.3.int: A quiet return to the Qur’an is already remembrance.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.4.int: If today feels heavy, keep the session small and sincere.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.5.tra: And We have certainly made the Qur’an easy for remembrance.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.5.int: Calm repetition is enough for today.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.6.tra: And be patient, for indeed Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.6.int: Showing up again matters more than finishing quickly.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.7.tra: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.7.int: Ask Allah for benefit in what you memorise, then begin gently.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.8.tra: And whoever puts their trust in Allah — He is sufficient for them.
memorisation.welcomeBack.reminders.8.int: Begin with trust, then take the next ayah with care.
memorisation.welcomeBack.resumeReminderT: As for those who strive for Us, We shall guide them to Our paths.

memorisation.emotional.postSession.encou: Small steps, repeated with sincerity, become lasting memorisation.
What you reviewed today has a place in your heart — return to it gently.
Consistency matters more than pace. You showed up, and that counts.
Each session is a quiet act of devotion. May it be accepted.
The Qur'an opens to those who return to it — keep coming back.
Steady effort, even in small portions, is beloved.

memorisation.emotional.milestone.streak3: Three days of showing up. Steadiness is its own quiet blessing.
memorisation.emotional.milestone.streak7: A week of consistency. May Allah make it easy to continue.
memorisation.emotional.milestone.streak1: Two weeks of returning to the Book. That rhythm is worth keeping.
memorisation.emotional.milestone.streak2: Three weeks of practice. Small daily efforts build something lasting.
memorisation.emotional.milestone.streak3: A month of showing up. May your connection to the Qur'an deepen.
memorisation.emotional.consistency.nudge: However long it's been, today is a good day to return.
A few days away — pick up gently, one ayah at a time.
Welcome back. There is no rush; begin where you are.
